question: Who is the legal counterparty to the BHP Antamina silver stream and what remains outside it?
entity_or_metric: BHP subsidiary versus Antamina JV perimeter
evidence_value: BHP FY2026 annual report says the stream was completed through a wholly owned BHP subsidiary; Antamina is not a party; BHP shareholder rights, JV obligations, existing customer agreements, and copper/zinc/lead exposure are unchanged
what_is_proven: The stream obligation and upfront cash are separated from the operating Antamina JV perimeter
